title: Biden-Trump TV Debate
content: On June 27, 2024, Biden and Trump participated in a televised debate where Biden's performance was widely criticized, raising concerns about his age and fitness for office.

title: Trump Shot at Rally
content: On July 13, 2024, former US President Donald Trump was shot during a rally in Pennsylvania but stood up and raised his fist to the crowd, showing resilience.

title: Trump Confirmed as Republican Nominee
content: House Speaker Mike Johnson announced Trump as the Republican presidential nominee, consolidating party support.

title: Biden Withdraws, Endorses Harris
content: On July 21, 2024, President Biden announced his withdrawal from the 2024 presidential race and endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris as the Democratic nominee.
